issues.description: build_msd_circ's second return value is documented inconsistently. The problem statement requires returning measurement indices for the destructive X-basis measurements of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits (in qubit order), but both the template and solution docstrings describe the second list as measurements of the distilled/output qubit ("distilled state"). The solution implementation actually returns indices for the 15 code-qubit MRX measurements, matching the problem statement but contradicting the docstrings, which can mislead students when indexing measurement results for error detection.
issues.suggestedFix: Update build_msd_circ docstrings (template and solution) so the second returned list is described as the measurement indices of the destructive X-basis measurements of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits, in qubit order (not measurements of the distilled/output qubit).
